evidence: Has the Mempool label and fixes mempool entry timestamp handling during mempool.dat loading.
rationale: Fixes an edge-case mempool expiry bug where loaded transactions with timestamps ahead of local time evade expiry policy. As described by the author, 'A mempool.dat entry with a time in the future is loaded as it is, so its transaction never expires, whatever -mempoolexpiry says.' Clamping to the current time correctly enforces expiry while addressing an uncommon clock-skew condition.
